name: Courtyard by Marriott Siem Reap Resort
short_description: Cambodia's first Courtyard by Marriott, this modern Siem Reap resort pairs Khmer-inspired design with a saltwater lagoon pool and a rooftop bar overlooking the city toward Angkor Wat.
ai_summary: Opened in 2018 as Cambodia's first Courtyard by Marriott, this 233-room resort sits in a quiet residential pocket north of Siem Reap's centre and has become a favourite value pick for Bonvoy members touring the Angkor temples. Independent reviewers consistently single out the service: staff are described as genuinely warm, attentive and unusually accommodating, arranging tuk-tuks, private guides and even off-menu meals for children. The Khmer-influenced rooms are praised as spacious, modern and immaculately clean, most with balconies overlooking a large freeform saltwater lagoon pool that includes a shallow kids' area and jacuzzi. The breakfast buffet earns repeated praise for its live cooking station and mix of Western, Asian and Cambodian dishes, though a few guests find the overall variety and the number of dining venues limited for a resort of this billing. Facilities include a fitness centre, Quan Spa, a lobby lounge and The Upper Deck rooftop bar, whose observation deck offers binoculars for distant temple views. As a Category 2 property it delivers strong redemption value, and elite members frequently report upgrades and complimentary breakfast. Watch-outs are minor and consistent: the location requires a short ride into town, occasional worn finishes or housekeeping lapses are noted, and spa or club-lounge availability has fluctuated. Overall the property reads as a reliable, family-friendly four-and-a-half-star base rather than a full luxury resort.

faqs.question: How far is the resort from Angkor Wat?
faqs.answer: The Courtyard by Marriott Siem Reap Resort sits about 8 km from Angkor Wat, roughly a 15-minute drive, making it a practical base for temple sightseeing. The staff readily arrange tuk-tuks, private cars and English-speaking guides, and its rooftop observation deck even provides binoculars for distant views toward the temples.

faqs.question: Is the resort close to Siem Reap town centre and Pub Street?
faqs.answer: Yes. Although the resort lies in a quieter area north of the centre rather than in the tourist core, Siem Reap's Pub Street, night markets and Angkor National Museum are only a short 10-minute ride away. Guests typically use the Grab app for inexpensive tuk-tuks into town throughout the day and evening.

faqs.question: What dining and facilities does the resort offer?
faqs.answer: The resort features a freeform saltwater lagoon pool with a shallow children's section, a fitness centre and Quan Spa offering Cambodian treatments. Dining includes the all-day Lok Lak restaurant serving Khmer and international dishes, a lobby lounge, and The Upper Deck rooftop bar known for cocktails and sweeping city views.

reviews.title: Review: Courtyard by Marriott Siem Reap Resort
reviews.author: Audrey Voisine
reviews.summary: A points-focused review rating the Category 2 resort 8/10, highlighting a Presidential Suite upgrade for Titanium members, generous breakfast, two connected pools and a rooftop terrace, plus strong fifth-night-free value.

reviews.title: Courtyard by Marriott Siem Reap Resort: My review
reviews.author: Emilita
reviews.summary: Praises the property as exquisite, noting the Courtyard brand feels more luxurious in Asia, with warm staff, spacious pool-view rooms, an oasis-like pool and an extensive Western-and-Asian breakfast buffet.

reviews.title: Review: Courtyard by Marriott Siem Reap Resort
reviews.author: Claire
reviews.summary: Covers Cambodia's first Courtyard, with 233 rooms in award-winning Khmer architecture, a freeform saltwater pool, jacuzzi, kids' pool, Quan Spa and The Upper Deck rooftop bar with 360-degree city views.
